description: This file defines service functions for managing recipes in a backend application. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting recipes, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions. It manages relationships with categories and tags, and contains internal utility functions for query construction.

methods.name: _apply_recipe_relations(stmt)
methods.description: Utility function to eager-load category and tag relationships for recipe queries.

methods.name: Recipe create_recipe( db: Session, *, author_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str], instructions: str, ingredients: str, category_id: Optional[int], tag_ids: List[int], )
methods.description: Creates a new recipe, attaches tags if provided, and saves it to the database.

methods.name: Optional[Recipe] get_recipe(db: Session, recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by ID, including related category and tags.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Recipe],int] list_recipes(db: Session, *, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of recipes along with total count.

methods.name: Recipe update_recipe( db: Session, *, recipe: Recipe, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, instructions: Optional[str] = None, ingredients: Optional[str] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None, tag_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None, )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing recipe, including tags if provided.

methods.name: None delete_recipe(db: Session, *, recipe: Recipe)
methods.description: Deletes a specified recipe from the database.
